ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Name the part G in the above diagram.
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left side of the image is a cross-sectional structure of a flower, with multiple letters labeling different parts. The indicator line of the letter G points to a long oval-shaped structure at the top of a slender filament next to the center of the flower. Reasoning: In the structure of a flower, the stamen is composed of the filament and the anther at the top, and the long oval-shaped part at the top that produces pollen is called an anther. Since G labels precisely these anther structures, the answer is Anthers.
